[short] skip
[compiler:gccgo] skip

# Test line numbers in cover errors.

# Test twice in different working directories to ensure
# errors don't leak paths from previous cached work.

mkdir $WORK/gopath1/src
cp go.mod $WORK/gopath1/src/go.mod
cp p.go $WORK/gopath1/src/p.go
cp p1.go $WORK/gopath1/src/p1.go
cp p_test.go $WORK/gopath1/src/p_test.go

mkdir $WORK/gopath2/src
cp go.mod $WORK/gopath2/src/go.mod
cp p.go $WORK/gopath2/src/p.go
cp p1.go $WORK/gopath2/src/p1.go
cp p_test.go $WORK/gopath2/src/p_test.go

cd $WORK/gopath1/src

# Get errors from a go test into stderr.txt
! go test coverbad
stderr '^\.[\\/]p\.go:4:2' # look for error at coverbad/p.go:4
[cgo] stderr '^\.[\\/]p1\.go:6:2' # look for error at coverbad/p.go:6
! stderr $WORK # make sure temporary directory isn't in error

cp stderr $WORK/stderr.txt

# Get errors from coverage into stderr2.txt
! go test -cover coverbad
cp stderr $WORK/stderr2.txt

wait # for go run above

cmp $WORK/stderr.txt $WORK/stderr2.txt

#
# Repeat in a second working directory.
#
cd $WORK/gopath2/src
! go test coverbad
stderr '^\.[\\/]p\.go:4:2' # look for error at coverbad/p.go:4
[cgo] stderr '^\.[\\/]p1\.go:6:2' # look for error at coverbad/p.go:6
! stderr $WORK # make sure temporary directory isn't in error
cp stderr $WORK/stderr3.txt
! go test -cover coverbad
cp stderr $WORK/stderr4.txt
wait
cmp $WORK/stderr.txt $WORK/stderr3.txt
cmp $WORK/stderr.txt $WORK/stderr4.txt

-- go.mod --
module coverbad

go 1.16
-- p.go --
package p

func f() {
	g()
}
-- p1.go --
package p

import "C"

func h() {
	j()
}
-- p_test.go --
package p

import "testing"

func Test(t *testing.T) {}
